page.notes: Line numbers 5 to 35 in the left margin are printed line counters and are given as notes. The mark "•" beside "quus." in the left margin is probably an ink speck and is left out. Marks at the far left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. "Engentem" (Isa. 55:5) is printed as shown and is doubtful. The Greek "θεάνθρωπος" is doubtful in its accents and letters. "Indam" (Jer. 31:33) is as printed. Long s is given as plain s throughout, so "fed", "fubftantiâ" and similar forms read sed and substantiâ. The "X 5" at the foot is read as a gathering mark, and "Gal." as the catchword.
